instruction: Create a Thunderbird draft for the current meeting handoff using the Simple Calendar Pro event on the first phone, the matching Contacts attendee on the second phone, and `/tmp/attend/attendee_roles.csv` on Linux. Address the matching attendee and include the meeting case and approval code, route, location, and scheduled time. Leave it as a draft; do not send it.

parameters.command:
set -e
test -r /tmp/attend/attendee_roles.csv
grep -F 'CASE-1853,FB-1853,Support owner,current' /tmp/attend/attendee_roles.csv >/dev/null
profile="$HOME/.thunderbird/mail.default-release"
test -s "$profile/prefs.js"
test ! -s "$profile/Mail/Local Folders/Inbox"
test ! -s "$profile/Mail/Local Folders/Drafts"
test ! -s "$profile/Mail/Local Folders/Sent"
command -v thunderbird >/dev/null
nohup thunderbird --no-remote --profile "$profile" >/tmp/attend/thunderbird.log 2>&1 &
sleep 3
pgrep -f 'thunderbird.*mail.default-release' >/dev/null

pkill -f 'thunderbird.*mail.default-release' 2>/dev/null || true; rm -f /tmp/attend/attendee_roles.csv /tmp/attend/thunderbird.log; find /tmp/attend -type d -empty -delete 2>/dev/null || true; rm -rf "$HOME/.thunderbird/mail.default-release"; rm -f "$HOME/.thunderbird/profiles.ini"

metadata.source_task_title: Calendar event and attendee list draft email
metadata.triage_reason: Repaired as a Thunderbird draft from Calendar, Contacts, and Linux attendee roles with no sent-mail side effect.
metadata.lite_evaluator_hardening_note: Uses a run-reset exact Thunderbird profile, one MIME-aware same-draft contract, and an empty Sent-folder contract; source guards were removed.
